tool_output_hint: Generated images are saved to C:\Users\14331\.codex\generated_images\01a1360d-0a44-7dc3-b50e-b64c02e42916 as C:\Users\14331\.codex\generated_images\01a1360d-0a44-7dc3-b50e-b64c02e42916\exec-5fb86846-c09b-41d6-961b-ce3713ce9be3.png by default.
prompt:
Use case: focused industrial-equipment boundary repair
Asset type: one standalone transparent PNG heating-furnace illustration for an editable industrial process diagram.
Input images: Image 1 is the current furnace component with one observed defect; Image 2 is the approved S02 concept that defines the correct furnace boundary.
Primary request: Repair only the overextended pipework on Image 1. Keep the same single furnace assembly and correct its outer silhouette to match the compact furnace visible in Image 2.
Preserve unchanged: the brushed-silver furnace body, bright rectangular orange combustion chamber, attached short fittings and valves, left-side tall exhaust stack, yellow safety platform and rails, dark support frame, base and feet, three-quarter view, materials, highlights, proportions and clean edges.
Correct only this defect: remove the oversized pipework loop extending far to the right of the furnace and any long tubes that reach toward neighboring equipment. Keep only compact pipe fittings that terminate close to and belong to the furnace housing. The approved furnace is the one upper-left unit in Image 2: a compact assembly with a roughly 1.3:1 width-to-height silhouette; the shared orange process route and all other equipment belong elsewhere.
Composition: keep the whole repaired machine centered and fully visible, with clear transparent padding and no crop.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA outside the furnace assembly; one machine only; no shadow plane. Keep all metal reflections and the orange fire glow attached to the device.
Avoid: redesigning the body, moving or removing the chimney/guardrails, changing viewpoint, adding any new pipe or device, long right-side tubes, exhaust tower, production line, tank/pump, heat exchanger, external process routes, arrows, badges, labels, typography, background, floor, grid, watermark or frame.

input_references.role: rejected furnace base; focused pipe-boundary correction
approved furnace boundary and style reference

review: Accepted after visual inspection: one compact furnace assembly with stack/platform, combustion chamber and local fittings; no other machine or flow path. Alpha >8 bbox is close to a 1.3:1 source component footprint. Some occluded detail was generatively reconstructed; not pixel-preserved.
